runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 20:18 sweep. Thirteen independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, public Facebook indexing, and broader direct-career discovery. LinkedIn surfaced Nexcess Technical Support Engineer in Bratislava at EUR 1,300-2,000 with remote work from Bratislava, no night shifts/overtime/phone support and only e-mail English, but Linux/terminal experience and deep networking knowledge are explicit requirements, so it is not promoted under the hard-development/specialized-skill penalty. Upwork surfaced a fresh WordPress/WooCommerce Technical Expert role posted yesterday, but it requires server-side performance, PHP, MySQL, caching/CDN and error-log diagnostics and already has 50+ proposals, so it is excluded. Kariera results included inactive foreign-language customer-support roles and current lower-paid Slovenska posta results; none warranted promotion. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Required-skill proof gap matrix
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For each otherwise strong support/web candidate, compare every explicit must-have against evidence already present in the master CV/portfolio and distinguish trainable gaps from hard rejection gaps; this prevents both over-rejecting junior roles and wasting applications on mandatory specialist stacks.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Source result activity signal
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Store last-viewed/client-activity or application-acceptance evidence separately from publication age so a recently crawled but abandoned marketplace listing is not ranked as fresh, while an older listing with active client behavior can remain actionable.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
